RFC 9449OAuth DPoP

OAuth 2.0 Demonstrating Proof of Possession (DPoP)

Abstract

This document describes a mechanism for sender-constraining OAuth 2.0 tokens.¶

Table of Contents

  • 1. Introduction

1. Introduction

DPoP is an application-level mechanism for sender-constraining OAuth access tokens and refresh tokens.¶

4. DPoP Proofs

A DPoP proof is a JWT.¶

4.3. Checking DPoP Proofs

To validate a DPoP proof, the receiving server MUST ensure the following:¶

  1. There is not more than one DPoP HTTP request header field.¶
  2. The typ JOSE Header Parameter has the value dpop+jwt.¶ 
DPoP: eyJ0eXAiOiJkcG9wK2p3dCJ9
  .eyJqdGkiOiItQndDM0VTYzZhY2MybFRjIn0
¶

4.3.1. Nonces

A server MAY supply a nonce.¶
